main_text.p: bellianorum errorem vitarent homines, hunc nouum nec minus periculosum temerarij excuderunt, quia ex suo sensu potius quàm ex ipsissimo Dei verbo sapere voluerunt, & dum vitant stulti vitia, in contraria currunt. Præterea Tritheitæ Dei naturam & essentiam triplicem faciunt, non autem vnam & eandem, vt docet Isidorus: & personas non tantùm reipsa inter se distinguunt, sed loco & situ separant & diuellunt, quemadmodum tres homines inter se totis subiectis & locis differunt, veluti Paulus, Petrus, Ioannes.
Sunt enim Tritheitæ, qui tres deos constituunt seorsim & reapse separatos à sese, non autem in vna & eadem diuina essentia tres hypostases diuersas & distinctas credunt.

Triformiani verò diuinam naturam vnam quidem & eandem in tribus personis constituunt, sed non totam. Cogitant enim diuinam essentiâ velut quiddam compositum vel aggregatum, quæ in tribus illis hypostasibus coalescentibus vel coniunctis inter se tota & perfecta fit: in singulis verò personis fit imperfecta. Itaque faciunt Trinitatem velut monstrum quoddam & corpus quod tribus diuersis formis tanquam capitibus constet, qualem suum Geryona finxerunt profani poetæ. Quo deliramento quid in tanta & tam sancta re, qualis est Sacrosancta Trinitas, fœdius & absurdius vel dici, vel etiam cogitari potest? Tetratheitæ etiâ à Triformianis differunt, & tempore & dogmate. page.notes: Printed "A" below the text is a signature mark (gathering signature), left out of the main text. Several words are in an uncertain print: "Tetratheitæ" appears as "Tetratheitę" in the scan, and the phrase "Geryona finxerunt" is clear; "tribus diuersis" reads as printed. Possible printing errors left as printed: "sensu" (likely "sensu"), "fit:in" with colon, "Tritheitæ" spelled as printed. Marginal mark (an asterisk-like sign) at the right of the line "Itaque faciunt" is a printer's or reader's mark, not a note, and is not transcribed. Words in the first paragraph and some Greek-style words may carry small inaccuracies from the scan; "Triformiani" and "Tetratheitæ" are transcribed as they appear.
